No. 1991/19 – TUESDAY NOVEMBER, 01, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
My No. : MCUDP/LA/St. Seb. North (W-09)/14/01.

Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4/3/10/2013/LRB/524. I, hereby give notice under Sub - section (1) of Section 7, of Land Acquisition Act as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the land described below to be utilized for the renovation activities & construction of access road for the use of canal bank maintenance of St. Sebestian (North) Canal and construction of a pump house under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project.
Description of the land to be acquired :

An allotment of land in total extent of 0.1744 Hectare depicted as lot No. 144, 145, 148, 149, 152, 154, 155, 158, 159, 162, 163, 168, 169, 172, 173, 176, 177, 179, 180, 181, 184, 187, 188, 191, 192, 195, 196, 199, 200, 203, 204, 207, 208, 211, 212, 215, 216, 219, 220, 223, 224, 227, 228, 231, 232, 235, 236, 239, 240, 243, 244, 247, 248 & 251 in the Amended Perliminary Plan No. Co. 9549 dated 01.08.2015 prepared by the Survey General Situated in the village called Kotahena in Ward No. 3, Mahawatta and Ward No. 6 Blumendal, in the Grama Niladhari Division of Mahawatta & Blumendal in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of in the Divisional Secretary’s Divisions of Colombo in Colombo District of Western Province and described as follows.
